استنبأت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْبَأْتُ (istanbaʔtu) /is.tan.baʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# اِسْتَنْبَأْتَ (istanbaʔta) /is.tan.baʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# اِسْتَنْبَأْتِ (istanbaʔti) /is.tan.baʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# اِسْتَنْبَأَتْ (istanbaʔat) /is.t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
